name: geodesign_robust_smoke
notes: Plumbing check of the robustness study, not for scientific conclusions: the geodesign smoke profile (outer domain cropped to a 2 km buffer, T = 7200 s, 2 + 2 + 2 cases) with the boundary profile shifted within T, refinement on the cropped 250 m grid with 1 + 2 cases, budgets 1 and 3. layouts_from must be given (CLI: robust.layouts_from, set below to a smoke geodesign run). Real geography; synthetic emissions and meteorology.
